title: Owner
publicOrdersOpen: Open — guests can order by scanning.
publicOrdersPaused: Paused — guests cannot place new orders.
publicOrdersNotReady: Not ready — publish a menu with at least one available item first.
storesSubtitle: Add a store or choose which one you want to work on.
overviewSubtitle: See whether the store is ready, then handle today's work.
paymentNote: Recorded payments are amounts your team entered manually. TaoMenu does not process customer money.
setupSubtitle: Complete these steps before you invite customers to scan.
setupQr: Create a table or pickup QR
freeTerminalLimit: Free includes 1 staff seat (2 seats total including the owner).
proTerminalLimit: Pro includes 4 staff seats (5 seats total including the owner).
ordersSubtitle: Accept orders, answer guest requests, and record payments in one workspace.
analyticsSubtitle: A simple view of today's recorded work. Historical reports can come later.
analyticsNote: TaoMenu reports orders and payments your team recorded today. It does not estimate scans, visitors, revenue outside the app, or payments that were not entered.
settingsSubtitle: Keep the store identity and ordering behavior clear for your team.
acceptingOrders: Allow guests to place new orders
acceptingOrdersHint: Pause this when the kitchen is closed or the team cannot take new orders.
upgradeSubtitle: Compare Free and Pro, then choose the plan that fits your store.
proActiveSubtitle: Your store can use the current Pro menu and team tools.
proBenefitImport: 20 photo or PDF menu imports each month
proBenefitTranslation: 20 reviewed AI menu translations each month
proBenefitEnhance: 10 reviewed AI dish photo previews each month
aiReviewRule: AI creates editable drafts only. Check names, prices, translations and images before you publish.
planBillingSuccess: Payment completed. Pro access may take a few seconds to sync.
planBillingCancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Your current plan did not change.
planBillingFailed: Could not open billing. Try again or contact support.
currencyChangeHint: Changing the currency does not convert existing menu prices or past order totals. The same numbers are simply read in the new currency, so update your prices by hand after switching.
currencyBillingHint: Your current subscription keeps billing in its original currency. Stripe requires every new subscription on the same account to use that first currency, so cancel the current subscription in billing management before you switch.
readOnlyHint: Menu language and store link name are shown for now. Contact support if you need them changed.
pairDescription: Generate a one-time QR code. Staff scan it, sign in, compare the code, and pair their device.
pairCodeInstruction: Have staff scan this QR, sign in, and compare the code on their device before pairing.
devicesSubtitle: Revoked devices lose access immediately. Push readiness is shown separately from access.
noDevices: No staff devices are paired yet.
revokeConfirm: Revoke this device? It will stop accessing the staff terminal immediately.
pairCodeFailed: Could not generate a pairing code.
staffSeatLimit: No staff seats are available. Buy an additional seat to continue.
staffSeatFullHint: All staff seats are in use. Revoke an old device or buy an additional seat before pairing another one.
billingSyncPending: Your previous purchase is still syncing. Try again in a moment.
